steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: How quick to answer, Doctor of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: A safe location has been sent to Alexandrina's terminal. Please stand by there. I cannot guarantee your safety for any actions you take outside of our arrangement.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: My terminal? When did...?!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You have some impressive talents among your ranks. That's very good. This should contribute to our common goal instead of becoming an obstacle to our cooperation.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Right?

options: This isn't completely up to us.
Is it a Victorian thing to call threats cooperation?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Of course. We must slowly build our trust.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: A cautious silence. How admirable.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Regrettably, yes.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Please await our next communication.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Doctor, I need to contact Closure and reevaluate the safety of Rhodes Island's communications. Until then, maintain radio silence.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Of course, we also need to... take care of the issues regarding the landship's calling procedures.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you, Ines.

options: Hello, Ines. Is this the first time we've met?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'm afraid not.

options: I've lost... some of my memories.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'm aware.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: This is our first meeting, for this version of you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Have you really lost your memories...? Or is this part of your plan?

options: I forgot about lots of things, indeed.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I've never been quick to judge, Dr. {@nickname}. I can sense that you've gone through some... changes.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We'll have a lot of time to get reacquainted in the future.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Rather than trusting verbal statements, I prefer to see things for myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ines, the Doctor...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Relax, Amiya. My prejudices won't be a factor.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: For now.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: The evacuation's almost complete!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good, we need to get out of here ASAP.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: That Sarkaz from Rhodes Island. Is his name Logos?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And I thought we'd seen all the surprises Rhodes Island's fighting style had to offer, having fought alongside Misery all this time.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Right. It doesn't matter who exactly he is. His cursecraft has been a great help.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Hah... and he's a great darts player, too.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: I played against him for a couple rounds. His accuracy might just be as terrifying as those Arts of his.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: A friend of mine taught me a couple tricks before, that's all.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: He's no match for me in a chair sliding match, but when it comes to darts... He's not so bad.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Horn, the Sarkaz forces have retreated. We should seize this opportunity.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: According to the plan, Rhodes Island and the Self-Salvation Corps will take the supply route, head toward the exit, and make their way to a town called Brentwood to build a new safe house there.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We will regroup with them there.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I suggest we charge toward the city walls. Norport Borough is gone, and even though the Sarkaz have patched up the walls, they wouldn't have had enough time to build new plates to fill the hole there.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The exposed underground structure might just help us somehow.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Looks like I've met another old friend.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: The one who taught you to play darts.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Regrettably, no.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Unlike this old friend, my friends are loyal to one another until our deaths.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Everyone, I'm afraid I still have matters to attend to within the city. Horn is more than capable of leading you outside Londinium, and my coworker Misery will also lend you his assistance should the need arise.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Stay hidden, everyone. Follow me.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Are the mountains of the past really so worthy of reminiscing? Blood and tears are nothing to be obsessed with.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: I must say I'm not entirely fascinated by them.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: But what if the mountains are the only place there is left to stay? What if only the light of glory there can give us warmth?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: And here I thought I'd hunted enough of you.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: This is the thirty-first 'Molly.' You are a hardworking one, Banshee.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But you prevailed nonetheless. You helped Theresis decimate the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: That's business.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I would pry up every tile in Londinium to find the last of your hidden shards, Damazti.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You yet refute the possibility of change. This has always been your choice.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: A little arrogant, aren't we, young Banshee? We understand change. We come from change itself.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: But change is merely a means to adaptation. All change has a final objective.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Even before the Sarkaz found themselves in this state, we had long been walking upon the lands.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Ideologies, faiths, missions, slogans. None of them can escape the sands of time.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Those ideas you mistake as novel have been conceived long ago. The paths you deem noble have been paved time and again.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: And where are they now?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We yet still before you.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: And that is the greatest proof.
(Bang!)
(Bang, bang!)

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You should save some strength, Cador. You've eaten more than enough.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Delphine has talked to you about your appetite problem already. We're much worse off than we used to be now.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Relax, Baird. Things haven't completely gone to shit yet.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Them devils aren't nearly as strong as they look. All they did was catch us off-guard.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I had a chat with Marshall from the transport union. They have a group of men over there. Once we rope in more people on our end, we might just stand a chance to defeat the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Just like how we joined forces with those other gangs to take the cops down.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Jump them from behind, get the job done clean. 'Pow pow,' 'bam!'

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: A couple punches. That's all it takes.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: The Sarkaz army isn't cops.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I know. They're a force to be reckoned with.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: But we aren't afraid of blood. We aren't afraid of sacrifices! We will walk over our fallen comrades, and smash their faces in with our fists—

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Like our gym's name, 'Slobberknocker!'

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Marshall and I worked it out. We will definitely win!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Just like those bootleg Lungmen videos you collect, hm?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I'm serious, I've been around the block in Norport not much shorter than you.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: We need to find a way out of this mess ourselves just like before.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: That Siege of yours just up and left Glasgow all those years ago, and our turf got handed over, just like that. It was you and I who racked our brains to figure out how to gain a foothold here again.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: This is nothing different than before. We stand together, get prepared, and beat them all up. That's how we've made it this far.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: It doesn't matter how things are outside. Out on the streets, we do things the street way.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Next, we just gotta find ourselves the right moment...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Looks like Delphine's back.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Did Ol' Baldy Per finally give in? Given the circumstances, we're paying a pretty decent price. I'm sure he—

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: What's this? Is that... blood?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Ol' Baldy Per is dead.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: The Sarkaz—

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: No, not the Sarkaz! Dammit, I have no idea who they were, but they were already at it when we got to the store!

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: They were a bloodthirsty bunch! I saw with my own eyes there was this man with a crowbar, pinning another man on the floor. That man even—

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: *cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The situation's bad. My guess is some starving bum set his sights on Per's shop. The idiot still had bread in his glass showcase.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: And it went as you'd expect.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: You can more or less guess just how many of these 'bums' there are in this locked-down district.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Bloody idiots... Whatever they have been sniffing must've finally got to their heads!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I know the man with the crowbar. He's a tail hair product salesman. Always had a smile on his face.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I bought from him a number of times since he gave me discounts. They aren't all that good, though.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I saw him just now... His eyes were deep red, there was blood on his lips. That crowbar was completely bent. I... I almost didn't recognize him.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Fear is spreading, Cador.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: The transport union guys did say there could be cowards going nuts, but how could...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Barricade the door!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: What are you spacing out for? Make yourself useful! Cador, push that sofa over here!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Bloody bastards, what do the lot of you want?!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Now piss off, we've got people alive in here. This is Glasgow's territory!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Baird, watch out!
A fire axe smashes through the gym's thick door and breaks open a hole. The sharp axe brushes past Baird's hair.
A few strands of her hair flutter in the air.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I said it already. We've got people still bloody alive in here!
Cador presses against the door with his body and grabs the axe peeking through the hole back with his two hands. The man outside makes several attempts to pull the axe back in vain.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I don't care who the hell you are, but get out of my sight, or I'll have this axe in your brain!
The axe wobbles a few times, and after a few heavy kicking sounds on the door, the men outside finally gives up, their chaotic footsteps slowly growing quieter.

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: Your hand... Your fingers...

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Good thing that bandages are the last thing we'll run out of in a gym.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Baird, Delphine. We need to take inventory of all our resources again.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I'll take down a couple sandbags to reinforce our front door.

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: Th-These people... Have they gone mad?!

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: They... The citizens of Norport Borough were all upstanding men, basically... What about the police? They were always so quick to write tickets!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: If I were a cop so unlucky as to not make it out of this plate in time, I would definitely have locked myself in my home with my weapon at the ready by now.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I... I need to head on over to the transport union later. The people here still trust Marshall.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: He—Everyone always listens to him. He'll find a way.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Dammit... Bloody hell! The Sarkaz are still out there. These people are out of their minds. How could they—

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: What... What should we do now? Cador said we just had to wait for...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: An opportunity?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Mr. 'Next Academician,' are you aware of the great fire in Norport fifteen years ago?

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: Oh, yes, I've heard. It was in the port, if I recall...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: It doesn't actually take very much to burn down a port.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: All you need is scorching hot weather, a warehouse full of wood shavings, and a cigarette butt not fully extinguished.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: No one can put out a fire like that.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: All we can do is watch everything burn to ashes.
